name: compatibility-check-app
description: AfinIA — monorepo (apps/backend NestJS, apps/frontend Angular, packages/shared-types)

scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm run lint --workspace=apps/backend && npm run lint --workspace=apps/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm run test --workspace=apps/backend && npm run test --workspace=apps/frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=apps/backend && npm run build --workspace=apps/frontend
